gameName: Heroes of Might and Magic III: The Board Game

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Heroes of Might and Magic III: The Board Game rulebook (Archon Studio, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Pick a {m} scenario from the Mission Book and set up its map and rules
steps.note: Tutorial: Brave New World (Mission Book p.7)

steps.text: Choose a faction: Castle, Dungeon or Necropolis (tie: highest Resource die roll picks first)
Choose one of your faction's Heroes as your Main Hero
Take your faction's Hero card, 2 Hero models, 7 Town Building tiles, Town board, 7 Unit cards, 3 Specialty cards and 1 Ability card for your Hero, 20 cubes, Build, Population and Spell Book tokens
Rounds alternate: Resource round (collect income), then Astrologers' round (draw a Proclaim card)
Advance the black cube on the Round tracker after every player's turn
